comment: Absolutely positioned boxes and the ink overflow of a box (a box-shadow) are clipped by an overflow: hidden ancestor in their containing-block chain, rounded corners included (a card with a ribbon and a glow); an overflowing absolutely positioned box is scrollable overflow of the nearest scroll container of its containing block (scrollbars appear; scrolled to the end in the second capture), not of a scroller its containing block is outside of. Rendered without MSAA ("samples": 1), at the default tolerances: with 4x MSAA, Mesa's llvmpipe and lavapipe (the test image's GL and Vulkan drivers, Mesa 23.2.1) let half the samples of the row above and the column left of a scissor rectangle through, so the content scrolled past the scrollers' clip edges would show a half-covered 1 px line there (MsaaScissor.FourSamples reproduces it with raw sokol calls).
